_meta.scope: Tracked checkout before generated H outputs; inherited editions preserved

findings.title: Superseded virtual-currency authority remains in inherited editions
findings.detail: The tracked corpus cites PBOC 2021 No. 237, but current PBOC 2026 No. 42 expressly repeals it. Edition H uses the current instrument and rejects crypto bridges without instructions.
findings.files: COORDINATION.md, EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md, data/sources.json, dossier/channels.html, dossier/sources.html (+39 more)
findings.disposition: Flagged; earlier editions preserved, Edition H corrected.

findings.title: Wise public quote drift
findings.detail: Earlier records contain CNY1,228.46 and CNY1,574.68 for two source amounts. On 2026-11-09 the provider pages displayed CNY1,228.50 and CNY1,574.72. Public quotes are dynamic and cannot be extrapolated into a fixed tariff.
findings.files: edition-g/build/build.py, edition-g/data/costs.json, edition-g/data/sources.json, edition-g/docs/costs.html, edition-g/docs/sources.html; edition-g/build/build.py, edition-g/data/costs.json, edition-g/data/sources.json, edition-g/docs/costs.html, edition-g/docs/sources.html
findings.disposition: Edition H records new observations only; old values not silently overwritten.

findings.title: Multiple historical BOC FX snapshots
findings.detail: Inherited pages contain the earlier USD100 ask 669.29. Edition H observed 669.19 at 2026-11-09 09:15:45 China time. BOC says its board is indicative and actual channel/counter rates control.
findings.files: COORDINATION.md, EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md, README.md, assets/build.py, data/channels.json (+37 more)
findings.disposition: Every H CNY scenario is timestamped and labeled non-executable.

findings.title: Future BOC ATM price change must not be applied early
findings.detail: A BOC notice changes some ATM pricing from 2026-11-11, two days after this research date. H uses the tariff effective on 2026-11-09 and records the future notice separately.
findings.files: COORDINATION.md, edition-e/build/make_data.py, edition-e/data/flags.json, edition-e/data/sources.json, edition-e/research/README.md (+21 more)
findings.disposition: No future price is used in current estimates.

findings.title: Official inheritance guide contains inconsistent eligibility wording
findings.detail: SAFE Hebei's inheritance guide repeats pre-immigration-property wording in its administrative conditions, while its definition and cited 2024 materials address inherited property. H follows the specific inheritance checklist and flags the inconsistency for local SAFE confirmation.
findings.files: Official source text, not a repository-authored defect
findings.disposition: Open official-source irregularity; no silent correction.

findings.title: All-in personal costs remain unverifiable
findings.detail: No account bank, receiving bank, source-of-funds breakdown, tax history, executable quote or document quote exists in the repository. Published sender fees and conditional scenarios cannot be promoted to total cost.
findings.files: Applies to all inherited numeric comparisons
findings.disposition: H leaves FX cost, downstream, documents, tax and all-in blank + UNVERIFIED.

findings.title: Historical staged emigrant-release wording is obsolete
findings.detail: Older 2004 provisions staged emigrant transfers. SAFE 2014 No. 2 removed that requirement; approved amounts can be remitted once or in installments within the approval. H uses the amended position and current service guide.
findings.files: Historical inherited editions and 2004 source text
findings.disposition: Current rule linked; older statements flagged rather than edited.

findings.title: Foreign-individual FIE dividend exemption has ended
findings.detail: Any inherited statement that foreign individuals remain exempt on FIE dividends is outdated for payments from 2026-09-01. MOF/STA 2026 No. 27 imposes 20% IIT and repeals the old exemption; treaty analysis remains separate.
findings.disposition: H uses 20% domestic rate and flags possible treaty relief as fact-dependent.

findings.title: U.S. remittance excise tax direction is easy to misread
findings.detail: The 1% tax from 2026 covers specified remittances sent from the United States using cash or similar physical instruments. It is not a China-to-U.S. charge and is excluded from every H cost grid.
findings.disposition: H marks the suggested addition N/A with an IRS source.

findings.title: BOC bid/ask gap is not a verified one-way spread
findings.detail: The current board's bid/ask gap is about 0.42%, but its ask 669.19 is below its reference 671.88. A round-trip gap or a comparison with that reference cannot establish the user's one-way conversion loss.
findings.disposition: H leaves FX cost blank and shows the actual CNY scenario instead.
